terms.meaning: a file where a website states which automated visitors may read which pages
a fingerprint of a file used to detect changes
a number estimating how much a source can be trusted
text patterns that point to one spot in a web page

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and setup
sections.what: Brings in column types, the JSON type, the link to the shared base and the portable UUID type.
sections.why: Likely reason: the Source and Extract classes need these tools.
sections.watch_out: JSON is imported on its own line, so keep it when editing the imports.

sections.name: Source
sections.title: Collected source record
sections.what: Defines the table for each web page, PDF or filing collected, with its link, publisher type, date, checksum, four credibility scores and whether crawling was allowed.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the evidence and its trust level together.
sections.watch_out: robots_allowed defaults to true, so a source that was never checked still looks allowed.

sections.name: Extract
sections.title: Single extracted data point
sections.what: Defines the table for one value taken from a source, with where it was found, the exact excerpt, the field name, value, unit, currency and confidence.
sections.why: Likely reason: each number can be checked against the original wording.
sections.watch_out: value_numeric keeps two decimal places, so values with more precision are rounded.

summary: Defines two tables: the web pages and documents collected as sources, and the individual data points taken from them.
purpose: Stores each collected source with its credibility scores, and each extracted value with the exact wording it came from.
why: Likely reason: every number in the benchmark must trace back to a source and an excerpt.
how: 1) Source rows record the link, publisher type, date, checksum, four scores and the robots.txt decision. 2) Extract rows record where the value was found, the excerpt, the field, the value, the unit, the currency and parse confidence.
inputs: Crawled pages and documents, and the values pulled from them.
outputs: Rows in the sources and extracts tables.
risks: The roughly 25 word excerpt limit is only a comment, not enforced. The robots decision is free text. Deleting a source deletes all of its extracts.
debug: If a value has no excerpt, check the verbatim field. If a source is missing, check its url and robots_allowed values.
